title: Horary
summary: HO'RARY, adjective [Latin horarius; Latin hora hour.] 1. Pertaining to an hour; noting the hours; as the horary circle. 2. Continuing an hour.

inlines.v: HO'RARY, adjective [Latin horarius; Latin hora hour.] 1. Pertaining to an hour; noting the hours; as the horary circle. 2. Continuing an hour.
